scope: Publicly documented 2026/27 U11 girls representative football matches and match reports involving a team in either the Southern Counties Girls' League or ESFA Girls' National KO. Internal public-repository research; separate from competition scoreboards.

rules.eligibility: Must directly involve a named participant in one of the two tracked competitions and girls' representative football for the comparable U11 cohort; reject boys, mixed, older age-group records unless participation established.
rules.competition_separation: Never add external form-match scores as National KO or Southern Counties Girls' League results.
rules.recalibration: External form is contextual only. Do not inject into title forecasts without explicit documented weighting, opponent verification and sensitivity checks.
rules.privacy: Do not store unpublished private match scores or identifying player-level details.

teams_of_interest.national_ko: 32 Round Two teams listed in /data.json; look up active entrants from that authoritative roster. Also consider 12 knocked-out Round One entrants when researching performances against survivors.
